contests.title: Fayette County school district — homestead exemption tied to tax collections

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Fayette County school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in a floating proportional amount based upon the amount of property taxes collected in a particular tax year that exceeds the value of property taxes collected in tax year 2025?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Fayette County school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in a floating proportional amount based upon the amount of property taxes collected in a particular tax year that exceeds the value of property taxes collected in tax year 2025?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Fayette County school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in a floating proportional amount based upon the amount of property taxes collected in a particular tax year that exceeds the value of property taxes collected in tax year 2025?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Creates a variable homestead exemption from Fayette County school district school-district property taxes beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. The formula compares total school-district property taxes collected from all properties with the amount collected in 2025. Qualifying excess collections would fund an exemption in the following tax year only if the increase over 2025 collections itself exceeds 100% of the 2025 amount; otherwise the following year’s exemption would be $0. The county Board of Education would choose the exemption’s dollar amount, applied equally to eligible homesteads, within the available set-aside funds plus interest; it could use less than all available funds, with unused money returned to the general fund. Assessed homestead value above the exemption remains taxable. It adds to other exemptions for these taxes and does not apply to state, county, city or independent-school-district property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the county tax commissioner; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed variable homestead-exemption formula based on tax collections above the 2025 baseline.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed variable homestead-exemption formula.
